title: Ɔhene a Ɔtwaa Asase no Awiei
intro: Fa w’adwene bu sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi, a wɔama no ahoɔden ne tumi wɔ asase no so. Saa onipa yi fii akwantu ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa ase, na oduu baabi a owia kɔtɔ ne baabi a epue, ohyiaa nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ nwonwa na ohyiaa asɛnnennen kɛse bi a efi aman abien a wɔreporɔw hɔ. Hena ne ɔkannifo a ɔyɛ ahintasɛm yi?
clues: Ná meyɛ sodifo a wɔama me tumi ne ɔkwan a mɛfa so adu asase so akyirikyiri.
Mituu kwan kɔɔ atɔe fam na mihuu sɛnea owia rekɔtɔ wɔ asubura bi a ɛyɛ kusuu mu.
Mihyiaa nnipa bi a wɔbɛn owia a ɛrepue a na wonni baabi a wɔbɛda afi ne hyew ho.
Mpɔtam foforo bi srɛɛ me mmoa tiaa aman abien a wɔporɔw a wɔfrɛ wɔn Gog ne Magog.
Mede dade ne kɔbere a wɔanwene yɛɛ akwanside bi de siw wɔn ano.
Mepaee mu kae se saa akwanside yi ye mmoborohunu a efiri m'Awurade ho, na ebetena so akosi mmere a woahyehye no.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
